🚨 Boletim de Cyber Segurança - Técnica

Infraestrutura - Docker / ESX / Elastic / Grafana / Nginx / VMware / Zabbix

🚨 CVE-2026-123508 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 3.1
Resumo:
Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains a supply chain vulnerability in its mage release targets that fetch the xgo module and Docker image by mutable latest references. Attackers who compromise the upstream xgo module, image, or registry can inject malicious code into subsequently built release binaries shipped under a valid signature.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-123508

Enterprise technology is fundamentally stronger when developed openly, shaped by diverse communities, and engineered for cross-environment interoperability rather than single-platform lock-in. 🚨 CISA Flags SonicWall SonicOS MFA Bypass Flaw Amid Reports of Possible Exploitation
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 7.1
Resumo:
Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added a high-severity vulnerability impacting SonicWall SonicOS to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports that it said may have been exploited in real-world attacks. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-19868 (CVSS score: 7.1 / 7.5), has been described as an authentication reinforcement
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/cisa-flags-sonicwall-sonicos-mfa-bypass.html
 
🚨 CVE-2026-123552 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.5
Resumo:
OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in certificate CRL checking that fetches CRLs from the distribution point named in a presented certificate without restricting the destination or verifying the downloaded CRL's signature. Attackers holding a trusted-CA-chained certificate can make OpenAM request internal hosts, capture configured CRL update credentials, overwrite stored revocat...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-123552
 
💣 U.S. Agencies Warn Refrigeration Controller Attacks Could Cause Fires and Inventory Losses
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
government agencies have warned that threat actors are actively targeting industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems globally with an aim to cause service disruptions, fire hazards, and loss of inventory. "The actors may exploit vulnerabilities or weaknesses in unpatched or internet-accessible controllers to remotely alter settings and force units into continuous heating
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/us-agencies-warn-refrigeration.html
 
💣 Web3Auth Flaw Exploited to Steal Keplr Crypto, Provider Empties Other Wallets for Safety
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Some people who set up a Keplr crypto wallet with their Google or Apple account have had money stolen by an attacker. Keplr uses a company called Web3Auth to run that Google and Apple sign-in. The attacker used a security flaw at that company to reach the wallets, both companies said late last week. Web3Auth then used the attacker's own route to empty other at-risk wallets before the attacker
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/web3auth-flaw-exploited-to-steal-keplr.html

🚨 CVE-2026-120836 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.5
Resumo:
Missing Authorization vulnerability in eLightUp Meta Box – WordPress Custom Fields Framework meta-box allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Meta Box – WordPress Custom Fields Framework: from n/a through 5.15.3.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-120836
 
📰 USN-9008-1: libnfs vulnerability
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/rss.xml
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
It was discovered that libnfs did not properly enforce the maximum size bound during ZDR decoding, resulting in an out-of-bounds write. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause libnfs to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or execute arbitrary code.
Link: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-9008-1

Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/rss.xml
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
It was discovered that FreeRDP contained multiple security issues. An attacker could possibly use these issues to obtain sensitive information, cause FreeRDP to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or execute arbitrary code.
Link: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-9007-1
